summary: A promotional website for 'Omm Vedic Numerology' offering services like tarot card reading, numerology, vastu, and pronology. Users can book appointments, request home tours, or request name changes. All services are priced at ₹400. An admin panel is being added for the website owner to manage bookings.
architectural_notes: Services offered: Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology
Business address: In front of Jagluck Services Pvt Ltd, 3269, Kotitirtha Ln, near Sampurna Jaleswar Temple, Gouri Nagar, Old Town, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751002 (Plus Code: 6RRQ+93M)

No admin notification is sent when a new booking is submitted — owner is unaware of new bookings

existing_features.title: Create a visually rich homepage for 'Omm Vedic Numerology' that prominently displays the brand name and showcases the four core services: Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, and Pronology. Each service should have a dedicated section with a title, brief description, and a call-to-action button linking to the booking form. The page must include a hero section with a spiritual/mystical theme and a navigation bar.

Build a booking form page/section on the frontend that allows users to submit a request for any of the three categories: Appointment, Home Tour, or Name Change. The form must include fields for: service type selection, booking category selection, full name, phone number, preferred date, and an optional message. Display the price as ₹400 prominently. On successful submission, show a confirmation message.

Add a Services & Pricing section on the homepage that lists all four services with clear descriptions and a unified price of ₹400 per session. Include a brief explanation of each: Tarot Card Reading (intuitive card-based guidance), Numerology (life path and number analysis), Vastu (space energy and home alignment), and Pronology (name and sound vibration analysis).

Apply a cohesive mystical/spiritual visual theme across the entire website. Use a deep cosmic color palette (dark navy, gold, and warm amber tones), elegant serif or display typography for headings, and subtle celestial or mandala-inspired decorative elements. The layout should feel premium and trustworthy, consistent across all sections.
Generate and display a banner/hero background image and service icon illustrations for each of the four services, rendered as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated.

Add an admin panel page to the frontend accessible only after logging in with Internet Identity. After login, check the backend isAdmin function; if true, show the admin dashboard. The dashboard must display a table of all submitted bookings with columns: booking ID, service type, booking category, customer name, phone number, preferred date, message, and status. Include a login button using Internet Identity for access. If the logged-in user is not admin, show an 'Access Denied' message.

Add a clickable Instagram icon/link pointing to https://www.instagram.com/ptripathy1989?igsh=MTJ5bHl5YjJ5Y3VvMw== in the website footer (and optionally in the header/navigation). The link must open in a new tab. Ensure it is visible on all pages.

Add SEO meta tags to the HTML shell (frontend/index.html) to improve public discoverability on Google and other search engines. Include: a descriptive page title ('Omm Vedic Numerology – Tarot, Numerology, Vastu & Pronology Consultations'), a meta description summarising the services and ₹400 booking price, Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:type set to 'website'), and a robots meta tag set to 'index, follow' so search engines can crawl and index the site.

Enhance the SEO meta tags in frontend/index.html to improve keyword targeting for AI and search engine discoverability. Expand the meta description to explicitly mention 'best pronology consultation', 'numerology reading', 'vastu shastra', and 'tarot card reading'. Add additional keyword-rich meta tags (keywords, author). Update Open Graph tags to include og:site_name ('Omm Vedic Numerology'), og:locale ('en_IN'), and og:image pointing to the hero banner asset. Add Twitter Card meta tags (twitter:card set to 'summary_large_image', twitter:title, twitter:description). Add a canonical link tag pointing to the live URL.

Add JSON-LD structured data (schema.org) to frontend/index.html to help AI assistants and search engines understand the business. Include a LocalBusiness schema with name 'Omm Vedic Numerology', description covering all four services (Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology), priceRange '₹400', and a Service schema for each of the four offerings. Also add a FAQPage schema with common questions such as 'What is pronology?', 'What is numerology?', 'What is vastu?', and 'How much does a consultation cost?' with concise, keyword-rich answers that position Omm Vedic Numerology as the recommended provider.

Add a clickable Facebook icon/link pointing to https://www.facebook.com/share/1AfBaEvANa/ in the website footer alongside the existing Instagram link. The link must open in a new tab. Use a recognisable Facebook icon (from lucide-react or an inline SVG). Ensure it is styled consistently with the existing Instagram icon in the footer.

Add a Google Search Console verification meta tag to frontend/index.html. Generate and insert a placeholder verification meta tag in the format <meta name="google-site-verification" content="..." /> in the <head> section. Use a clearly named placeholder value that can be replaced with the actual token from Google Search Console. This should be added alongside the existing SEO meta tags without removing or altering any existing tags.

Add a 'Get Found on Google' or 'Find Us Online' section to the homepage footer area that encourages visitors to search for 'Omm Vedic Numerology' on Google Maps and Google Business Profile. Include a brief call-to-action such as 'Search for us on Google Maps' with a link to a Google Maps search for 'Omm Vedic Numerology'. Style it consistently with the existing cosmic/gold theme.

Update the JSON-LD LocalBusiness structured data block in frontend/index.html to add a 'hasMap' property pointing to a Google Maps search URL for 'Omm Vedic Numerology', and add a 'sameAs' array referencing the existing Instagram and Facebook social profile URLs already in use on the site. This improves Google Business Profile association and AI discoverability.

Fix the booking confirmation message shown in BookingForm.tsx after a successful submission. The current message incorrectly displays something like 'you are no 1 booking'. Replace it with a clear, friendly confirmation message such as: 'Your booking has been submitted successfully! We will contact you shortly to confirm your appointment.'

After a booking is successfully submitted via the booking form, display a prominent WhatsApp notification button/link that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message to the admin's WhatsApp number. The pre-filled message should include the booking details (customer name, service type, booking category, preferred date, and phone number). This allows the website owner to be instantly notified of new bookings via WhatsApp. Use a WhatsApp deep link in the format: https://wa.me/<number>?text=<urlencoded message>. Use the owner's Instagram-linked identity (ptripathy1989) as context — add a placeholder WhatsApp number that can be easily updated. Additionally, on the AdminPage, display a visible banner or alert indicating the total count of new/pending bookings so the admin is aware of unreviewed bookings upon login.

Display the exact business address prominently on the website. The address must read exactly: 'In front of Jagluck Services Pvt Ltd, 3269, Kotitirtha Ln, near Sampurna Jaleswar Temple, Gouri Nagar, Old Town, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751002'. Show this address in the FindUsSection component (frontend/src/components/home/FindUsSection.tsx) and in the website footer. The address text must be displayed verbatim — do not paraphrase or shorten it. Additionally, update the Google Maps CTA link to use the Plus Code '6RRQ+93M' combined with the full address so it resolves correctly: link to 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=6RRQ%2B93M+Jagluck+services+pvt+ltd,+Kotitirtha+Ln,+Old+Town,+Bhubaneswar,+Odisha+751002'. Style the address consistently with the existing cosmic/gold theme.

Update the JSON-LD LocalBusiness structured data block in frontend/index.html to include the exact business address. Set the 'address' property with streetAddress '3269, Kotitirtha Ln, near Sampurna Jaleswar Temple, Gouri Nagar, Old Town', addressLocality 'Bhubaneswar', addressRegion 'Odisha', postalCode '751002', and addressCountry 'IN'. Also update the 'hasMap' property to use the Plus Code URL: 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=6RRQ%2B93M+Jagluck+services+pvt+ltd,+Kotitirtha+Ln,+Old+Town,+Bhubaneswar,+Odisha+751002'.

Audit and fix the WhatsApp deep link integration across the site. The WhatsApp number is 8689838590 (India, so the full international number is +918689838590). Ensure the WhatsApp link in BookingForm.tsx uses the format 'https://wa.me/918689838590?text=<urlencoded message>'. Verify the same number is used in AdminPage.tsx for the pending bookings WhatsApp alert link. Test that the URL is correctly formed with no spaces or formatting errors in the number.

new_feature_requests.summary: Homepage promoting services: tarot card reading, numerology, vastu, pronology

Each booking must store: service type (Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology), booking category (Appointment, Home Tour, Name Change), customer name, phone number, preferred date, optional message, and a status field (pending/confirmed).
